items.title: Ferrand Clementin Interview, 1973-08-02
items.q: And Father Frank said, he wanted twenty thousand dollars. He got it.

ctx.x: I used to come to those bazaars up there. Yeah. Father Turner before him, huh? Yeah, Father Turner before him. Yeah, I used to come there all the time because Louis James was an old friend of mine. Yeah.
And Father Frank said, he wanted twenty thousand dollars. He got it. He got it.
